description: Builds Redfish URIs locally and sends them to remote OOB controllers to get information back.

parameters.name: auth_token
parameters.description: Security token for authenticating to OOB controller.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. Only used if validate_certs=true.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: List of categories to execute on OOB controller. Default: ["Systems"]

parameters.name: ciphers
parameters.description: TLS/SSL Ciphers to use for the request. When a list is provided, all ciphers are joined in order with :. See the OpenSSL Cipher List Format for more details. The available ciphers is dependent on the Python and OpenSSL/LibreSSL versions.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: List of commands to execute on OOB controller.

parameters.name: manager
parameters.description: Name of manager on OOB controller to target.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password for authenticating to OOB controller.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests to OOB controller. The default value for this parameter changed from 10 to 60 in community.general 9.0.0. Default: 60

parameters.name: update_handle
parameters.description: Handle to check the status of an update in progress.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username for authenticating to OOB controller.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, TLS/SSL certificates are not validated. Set this to true to enable certificate checking. Should be used together with ca_path. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Get CPU inventory
  community.general.redfish_info:
    category: Systems
    command: GetCpuInventory
    baseuri: "{{ baseuri }}"
    username: "{{ username }}"
    password: "{{ password }}"
  register: result

- name: Print fetched information
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ result.redfish_facts.cpu.entries | to_nice_json }}"
